msItem.title: Ya-ʿUrā Masqal dabdābbe, Land-charter of ʿUrā Masqal

list.item: 7 I(7/fols. 1r-7v; s.l.: 1, no stub) The structure of quire I can not be established with certainty due to the condition of the present Ms.

supportDesc.condition: The boards and the spine cover are missing. The sewing is severely damaged. The Ms. is slightly worn and loosely held together. Text on 4r, 7r, 8r, 10r, 11v is barely legible due to faded ink, esp. red.

layout.ab: The upper line is written above the ruling.
The bottom line is written above the ruling.

item.desc: The title ደብዳቤ፡ የመስቀል፡ is written in the lower margin on fol. 11v with blue paint.
The scribe used compressed script: fols. 5v, 6r, 8r, 9v, 10r.
Corrections written interlineally in red ink: fol. 7r.

binding.decoNote: One pair of sewing stations. Quire I is crudely held together by a modern thread.
A small hole is visible on the spine fold of quire II, close to the head of the codex.
